items.quote: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people
items.claim: Moses' father-in-law observed all that Moses did to the people
items.object: all that he did to the people

items.quote: why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
items.claim: Moses sits alone while all the people stand by him from morning to evening

items.quote: Because the people come unto me to enquire of God
items.claim: The people come to Moses to inquire of God

items.quote: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
items.claim: Moses judges disputes between people and teaches them God's statutes and laws
items.object: a matter, the statutes of God, and his laws
